_comment: GitHub MCP is BUILT INTO Copilot CLI — no configuration needed!
_description: This file is a reference showing the tools available via the built-in GitHub MCP server. You do NOT need to add this to your config.

code_search.description: Search code across GitHub repositories using GitHub's native search engine

repository_search.description: Find repositories by name, description, topics, or other metadata

user_search.description: Find GitHub users by username, name, or profile info

file_contents.description: Read file or directory contents from any accessible repository

pull_requests.description: List, search, and inspect PRs — diffs, reviews, comments, check runs

issues.description: List, search, and inspect issues — comments, labels, sub-issues

actions.description: List workflows, inspect runs/jobs, download artifacts, read logs

usage_notes: All GitHub MCP tools are available immediately when Copilot CLI starts
Authentication uses your existing GitHub credentials (gh auth)
Tools respect your repository access permissions
No token or API key configuration is needed
